description: This file defines enums, structs, and inline functions for emitting formatted output (JSON or table) in the jemalloc internal codebase, specifically related to an emitter utility.

methods.name: emitter_row_init
methods.description: Initializes an emitter_row_t structure by setting up its internal linked list.

methods.name: emitter_col_init
methods.description: Initializes an emitter_col_t structure and links it to a given row.

methods.name: emitter_init
methods.description: Initializes an emitter_t structure with output mode, callback, and opaque data.

methods.name: emitter_printf
methods.description: Outputs a formatted string to the emitter's write callback.

methods.name: emitter_table_printf
methods.description: Outputs a formatted string only if the emitter is in table mode.

methods.name: emitter_gen_fmt
methods.description: Generates a printf format string based on justification and width.

methods.name: emitter_print_value
methods.description: Prints a value of a specified type with formatting and justification.

methods.name: emitter_nest_inc
methods.description: Increments nesting depth and resets item_at_depth flag.

methods.name: emitter_nest_dec
methods.description: Decrements nesting depth and sets item_at_depth flag.

methods.name: emitter_indent
methods.description: Outputs indentation based on current nesting depth and output mode.

methods.name: emitter_json_key_prefix
methods.description: Outputs a comma and indentation before a JSON key.

methods.name: emitter_begin
methods.description: Starts an emission block, either JSON object or tabular.

methods.name: emitter_end
methods.description: Ends a JSON emission block.

methods.name: emitter_kv_note
methods.description: Outputs a key-value pair with optional note, in JSON or table mode.

methods.name: emitter_kv
methods.description: Outputs a key-value pair in JSON or table mode.

methods.name: emitter_json_kv
methods.description: Outputs a JSON key-value pair if in JSON mode.

methods.name: emitter_table_kv
methods.description: Outputs a table key-value pair if in table mode.

methods.name: emitter_dict_begin
methods.description: Begins a dictionary block in JSON or table mode.

methods.name: emitter_dict_end
methods.description: Ends a dictionary block.

methods.name: emitter_json_dict_begin
methods.description: Begins a JSON dictionary.

methods.name: emitter_json_dict_end
methods.description: Ends a JSON dictionary.

methods.name: emitter_table_dict_begin
methods.description: Begins a table dictionary.

methods.name: emitter_table_dict_end
methods.description: Ends a table dictionary.

methods.name: emitter_json_arr_begin
methods.description: Begins a JSON array.

methods.name: emitter_json_arr_end
methods.description: Ends a JSON array.

methods.name: emitter_json_arr_obj_begin
methods.description: Begins a JSON array object.

methods.name: emitter_json_arr_obj_end
methods.description: Ends a JSON array object.

methods.name: emitter_json_arr_value
methods.description: Outputs a value in a JSON array.

methods.name: emitter_table_row
methods.description: Outputs a row in table mode.
